spec.situation_desc: couldn't pay a bill on time because the mobile app was down
spec.vuln_cue: says they don't really understand online banking and their son normally does it

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Zara speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s Jasper Ellingham. I couldn’t pay my electricity bill because your app was down, and now I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can look into that. First, can you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right. What happened with the bill?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It was due on Monday. I tried the app all afternoon, but it wouldn’t work, and now they’ve charged me a late fee.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’ll be refunded, then. I’ll log this as a complaint for you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I don’t really understand online banking. My son normally does it for me, but he was away.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Okay. The Financial Support team can help with that, or we can allow extra time for payments. I’ll note it.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So what happens now? I don’t want this happening again.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Someone will be in touch about the complaint. I can’t say more at this point.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Will the late fee definitely come back into my account?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes, it’ll be refunded. I’ve logged the complaint.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And I don’t need to do anything else?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ve summarised it: the app stopped you paying, I’ve logged a complaint, and someone will be in touch. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, I think so. Thank you.
